facts.statement: SOE released a 'Super Secret Stuff' video, hosted by artist Misty Michelle, showing concept art and environments for the Sunstone Valley region.
facts.quote: The latest "Super Secret Stuff" video hosted by artist Misty Michelle offers a peek behind the curtain

article_summaries.title: SOE Offers a Peek at Free Realms' Upcoming Sunstone Valley Region
article_summaries.summary: A Ten Ton Hammer news post, based on an SOE press release, announcing a 'Super Secret Stuff' video by artist Misty Michelle that shows concept art and environments for the upcoming Sunstone Valley region of Free Realms. The article gives no mechanics, quests, prices or release details beyond saying more video about the region's new content would follow.
